links.why: A clause cannot be joined to itself; the builder's self-link is a parser artifact.
Plain waw joining two descriptions of the earth and the darkness; no cause, result or sequence is stated.
Plain waw joining the darkness clause to the clause about the Spirit; both are descriptions, not a sequence of acts.
Direction reversed: 'then' runs from the earlier event to the later one. The saying (cl0) comes before the light that comes to be (cl2), not after it.
cl1 is the jussive said inside the speech, not a clause on the narrative line. The narrative event after the saying is cl2.
links.category: speech clause taken as narrative line

links.why: wayyiqtol cl2 continues the narrative line; its nearest preceding clause not inside a speech is cl0 (he said).
The saying clause (he said God) introduces the words that follow, which are the jussive. Both are also placed in turn0 as frame and part.
The command let there be light is followed by waw plus a wayyiqtol stating what came of it (and there was light). The same clause is the effect of imp1.

groups.why: God is the one speaking (he said God); the jussive is what is said.
'part' is not a member role of the imperative kind. The clause that states what the command brought about is its effect.

links.why: saw that the light was good: the clause is what was seen, the object of the verb, not a reason for it.
Direction reversed: the separating (cl2) comes after the seeing (cl0), not before it.
wayyiqtol cl2 continues the narrative from the seeing in cl0. cl1 is embedded as cl0's object and is not on the line.

referents.why: Third masculine singular qatal with the subject unstated. It is the same actor as cl0 (God called the light day); Elohim takes a singular verb; the BSB gives He.
referents.category: implied subject carried over from the clause before

links.why: Plain waw joining two parallel namings by the same agent (the light, the darkness). No cause or sequence is stated.
Direction reversed, and not the nearest preceding narrative clause: wayyiqtol cl2 follows cl1, so the line runs cl0, cl1, cl2.
wayyiqtol cl2 (and there was evening) continues the narrative line from cl1, the nearest preceding clause not inside a speech.
wayyiqtol cl3 (and there was morning) continues from cl2 (and there was evening).

none_fit.what: Naming: called the light day and called the darkness night give a name as the object. No link type records naming a thing by a word.
Identifying apposition: 'the first day' names the evening and morning of cl2 and cl3 together. No link type covers an identifying apposition over two clauses.
